description: This Java class defines configuration properties for Hono's device registration API, specifically managing the maximum number of devices per tenant and the default filename for device identities.

classes.name: FileBasedRegistrationConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties for Hono's registration API as an own server, managing device registration limits and file location.

methods.name: getMaxDevicesPerTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of devices that can be registered for each tenant.

methods.name: setMaxDevicesPerTenant
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of devices that can be registered for each tenant, throws IllegalArgumentException if input is invalid.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to provide the default filename for device identity JSON.
